lead: What to tell you, what comes back, and how long it takes — then a button to wherever the form actually lives.
note: The element renders the panel and the call to action only. It has no fields, and nothing a visitor types is collected, stored or sent by it.

steps.title: What you send
steps.text: Named precisely, so nobody has to guess what a useful enquiry contains.

steps.title: What happens next
steps.text: The step most panels leave out, and the one that decides whether the button is pressed.

steps.title: What comes back
steps.text: A document, a call, a number — say which.

steps.title: How long it stands
steps.text: An offer with no stated life is one that has to be asked about again.
